fees.notes: Official Linton University College fee schedule effective 1 Feb 2014 (archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20141231060716id_/http://www.linton.edu.my/admission/financial-fees): 4-year tuition RM85,275 total (RM22,080 + RM21,065 x 3); approximate all-in RM100,475 including external fee RM8,000 and miscellaneous charges RM7,200. Linton's domain no longer resolves (DNS NXDOMAIN, checked 2026-09-18) and no newer official fee schedule was found in Wayback archives (2015-2024).
